purpose: Centred hero on /startups, /roadmap, /lightdash-security and /jp: Template A title (display-56 or 72) between dashed rules, subtitle, optional button pair, optional corner pixel tiles.
implementedBy: inline in src/pages/Startups.jsx, Roadmap.jsx, LightdashSecurity.jsx, Jp.jsx (pixel tiles: src/components/pages/startups/PixelTiles.jsx on startups/jp)

responsive.change: top spacer 100 -> 56 (security) and the h1 drops from 56px to 42px on /roadmap and /lightdash-security, 36px on /startups, 32px on /jp
only some left-cluster pixel tiles show (startups 3, jp 3)

notes: /jp is Japanese copy (lang ja glyphs fall back to the OS CJK font; src/pages/Jp.jsx:7). Roadmap pixel strips are 16px and slide in (roadmap-pixel-slide); startups/jp tiles drop (pixel-drop).

Startups "Talk to our team" links to a live Cal.com page (lightdash.cal.com/lightdash/startups) and /jp "デモ予約" links to the absolute live URL https://www.lightdash.com/start: both are live endpoints that a PageSpec must express as open-talk-modal / navigate-route, never copy. Japanese copy has no spaces, so whitespace word counts treat a Japanese sentence as 1 word: maxWords is not a meaningful budget for /jp copy.
Startups renders two heading spans ("Lightdash for startups" phone / "Lightdash for Startups" desktop); the PageSpec carries the desktop casing.
